briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 push AGI frontier as compute arms race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple new models this month amid record funding. Prompt injection attacks continue to dominate security discussions while regulatory pressure mounts in the US and EU.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with multimodal reasoning; Anthropic released Claude 4; Google launched Gemini 3. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 weights while xAI and DeepSeek announced competitive training runs.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines emphasize runtime monitoring for multi-agent systems.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 1M units; Microsoft and Google announce $40B combined data center expansions. TSMC reports AI chip shortages through Q2 2027.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI system emerge from a US lab or a Chinese state-backed consortium by 2028?
